---
title: "Common Problems"
---

You may have keybindings set for your computer that supersede the keybindings set in Emacs. For example, macOS takes `C-<up>`, `C-<down>` and `C-<right>` for Mission Control and Application windows. To disable these keybindings, go to your Apple Menu \> System Settings \> Keyboard \> Keyboard Shortcuts and then locate the settings you’d like to disable. Uncheck them. Full instructions for Macs can be found [here](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/keyboard-shortcuts-mchlp2262/mac).

Emacs is on the older side. Newer installations seem to have some problems with loading in some packages. If a package does not install when Emacs starts, install it yourself with `M-x package-install`, or from the list that `M-x list-packages` opens.
